After suffering the loss of his family to the plague, [[Bryan]] wishes to leave [[Cantha]] and return to [[Ascalon]]. Help him find passage home.

== Quest information ==

=== Objectives ===
* Find a ship willing to carry a passenger to Ascalon.
* Seek out [[Captain Joran]] in [[Wajjun Bazaar]].
* See Bryan for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 3,000 [[Experience]]
* 175 [[Gold]]
* [[Imperial Commendation]]

== Walkthrough ==
From [[Kaineng Center]], go to [[Bejunkan Pier]] and speak to [[Armian]]. He will tell you to see Captain Joran in Wajjun Bazaar. Speak to Captain Joran, who will agree to take Bryan along. Return to Bryan in Bukdek Byway to collect your reward.

== Dialogue ==

=== Initial dialogue ===
; Bryan
: ''"After the [[Charr]] invaded Ascalon, I fled to [[Cantha]] with my family. We were just starting to settle into our new life when this [[Afflicted|horrible plague]] swept through the city.  My wife and children all succumbed to it, and now I am alone.  Some nights, my grief is too great to bear, and I wish I would just die.  But I don't want to die in this place. I want to go home...to Ascalon.  Please, go down to '''Bejunkan Pier''' and see if there are any ships willing to take me back to Ascalon."''
{{offer dialog
| accept = I'll see what I can do.
| decline = Find your own ship.
| ask = Ascalon is calling me home. Please, search the '''Bejunkan Pier''' for a ship that will take me there. 
| indent = :: }}


=== Intermediate dialogue ===
; Armian
: ''"Someone requires passage to Ascalon, huh? Well, I don't know if we can take him all the way, but we're leaving port and heading to [[Lion's Arch]] with the next tide. I recommend you find Captain Joran, who's at Wajjun Bazaar on some business. The final decision is his to make."''

; Captain Joran
: ''"An Ascalon{{sic}}<!-- Shouldn't this be "Ascalonian"? --> looking for passage back home? I can help, but he'll have to earn his keep. I won't tolerate useless hands aboard the Sea Swift. Tell him to meet me at the docks, and I'll see to it he gets as far as Lion's Arch. He'll have to make his way from there to Ascalon himself."''

=== Reward dialogue ===
; Bryan
: ''"You found me passage to Lion's Arch? That's wonderful! It might not be Ascalon, but it's halfway there! You have my gratitude."''

== Notes ==
* It is recommended that you not have [[Chasing Zenmai]] active when accepting or completing this quest.  Bryan is hostile to enemies so when you approach him, [[Am Fah]] will spawn near him and attack.  Either complete Chasing Zenmai first or abandon it before accepting or completing Going Home.
